title: SPI-Math Generator Module Descriptor
description: The self-description (describe() output) of a versioned question generator module. This is metadata about a generator, not the generator code. It declares the contract a generator fulfils so the platform can discover, configure, validate, and version it. The generation/solve/validate logic lives in code; this descriptor must stay in sync with it and is itself versioned.

generatorVersion.description: Semantic version. A change in generation/solve/distractor/solution logic that alters output REQUIRES a new version. Never silently change a published version.

supportedObjectives.description: Curriculum objective IDs this generator can produce items for.

rngAlgorithm.description: Named seeded PRNG. Must be deterministic and cross-language portable. Default mulberry32 per Decision #10.

parameterSpec.description: Declares each tunable parameter, its type, and constraints. Generation must always produce params within this spec; validate() rejects out-of-spec configs.

difficultyControls.description: Which difficulty axes this generator exposes and how its config maps to them.

axis.description: Difficulty axis name (see DIFFICULTY_MODEL.md / question-item difficultyProfile.axes).

controlledBy.description: Parameter names that drive this axis.

config.description: Generation configuration accepted by generate(seed, config). Includes target objective, target difficulty band, allowed tasks, ranges, and answer type. Must validate against parameterSpec.

operations.description: Declares which contract operations the generator implements. All generators must implement the required set.

canonicalMethod.description: How solve() computes the canonical answer (e.g. 'closed form u_n = u1 + (n-1)d').

independentValidationMethod.description: The INDEPENDENT method validate() uses to verify the answer, which must differ from the generation/solve method (e.g. 'iterative term-by-term construction and comparison'). Required by the independent-verification principle.

distractorRules.description: Distractor strategies, each tied to a misconception.

rule.description: How the wrong value is computed.

misconceptionMappings.description: All misconception IDs this generator can surface.

renderingRequirements.description: e.g. 'KaTeX for notation', 'SVG diagram from params'.

keyFields.description: Param fields forming the structural key.

maxDuplicateRate.description: Allowed structural-duplicate fraction across a seed sweep.

seedSweepCount.description: Number of seeds tested for stability (target >= 10000 when reasonable).

goldenSeeds.description: Fixed seeds whose output is checked into version control as golden.

examples.title: Arithmetic Sequences
examples.description: Generates arithmetic-sequence items: nth term, sum of first n terms, and selected reverse tasks.
examples.canonicalMethod: Closed form: u_n = a1 + (n-1)d; S_n = n/2 (2 a1 + (n-1) d).
examples.independentValidationMethod: Iterative construction: build terms a1, a1+d, ... up to n and compare nth term and running sum to the closed-form results.
